test_case_info.test_case_name: Verify the screen, when user clicks on the 'Create your own shortcut' arrow button in 'Add new shortcuts' screen.

test_case_details.title: Verify the screen, when user clicks on the 'Create your own shortcut' arrow button in 'Add new shortcuts' screen.
test_case_details.custom_preconds:
1.Make sure that the supported printer is added on the root view.
2.Ensure that the user is logged into the account.
test_case_details.custom_steps:
1.Install and Launch the HPX app.
2.Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
3.Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
4.Click on Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
5.The click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
6.Verify the screen.
test_case_details.custom_expected: User should be navigated to the 'Add shortcut' screen.
